scope: Complete compressed waveforms and logs for bounded board bridge controls. The fault control intentionally exits after detection and restoration; its waveform does not cover the full positive window.
restore: Copy shared inputs into each run directory; readers accept .xz directly. Build the pinned Icarus observer and isolated shim with the retained build recipes before rerunning. The frozen producer resolves the repository from build/keyboard-controller-analog.
limitations: Queued times, order, scheduler regions and event classes only. Event payloads, executing callbacks, thread internals and freed storage are not serialized. No full-window or general rollback claim.
